items.title: Apple just did something rare that signals big September event
items.snippet: Apple’s ‘Surprise and shine’ event is set for September 9, but the company already surprised us this week by launching new products in late August. Here’s why that rare move could signal big things coming at the September event. If you follow Apple closely, you start to notice patterns in the company’s calendar year. New products typically launch around March, then June brings WWDC and software unveilings, followed by a big September event, and often some October launches too. While it’s not unusual to see smaller products debut via press releases throughout the rest of the year, one thing is exceptionally rare: a late August product launch. Over the past 10 years, Apple has only once launched new hardware in August. That lone product was the iMac in 2020—but it debuted early in the month on August 4. Why don’t late August launches happen? Because having a September event right around the corner means new hardware would typically be held until then. The Apple logo accompanying the 2026 event invite Regular as clockwork, Apple holds an event in early September to launch new iPhone models and other products. Apple has just confirmed that this will be the case for 2026's presentation. Titled "Surprise and shine," the event will be taking place on September 9, starting at 10 A.M. Pacific, 1 P.M. Eastern Time. As usual, it will be streamed on YouTube, the Apple Event page, and the Apple TV app, among other methods. Continue Reading on

items.title: How to use digital IDs in Apple Wallet & where they are supported
items.snippet: In a growing number of states, now including Virginia, you can add your ID to Apple Wallet . Here's how to add them, how they work, where they are, what the limitations are, and what they can do. A digital driver's license in the Apple Wallet app We're moving closer and closer to a world where you can ditch your physical wallet. You can already add your credit cards, debit cards, loyalty cards, tickets and boarding passes, and most recently — your driver's license to Apple Wallet. But the license rollout is not everywhere. This has increased the uncertainty on whether or not your ID can be added and if it can be, where it can be accepted. Continue Reading on AppleInsider | Discuss on our For

items.title: This iPhone Ultra teaser is almost as good as Apple launch videos
items.snippet: If this is not how Apple presents the iPhone Ultra , perhaps it should be. A YouTuber has produced a concept video showing how the new device might be used, and launched. Detail from a concept video showing what the iPhone Ultra could be like - image credit: Gunho Lee. It will probably be September 9, 2026 when John Ternus presents the long-awaited foldable, the iPhone Ultra. He'll do it in a pre-recorded video that will definitely be slick, and definitely persuade you to want to buy. What it won't be is the new video that is being circulated as a concept. While it does have an on-screen credit for a voiceover by John Ternus, it doesn't even try to mimic his voice. Continue Reading on AppleI

items.title: World's best selling smartphone is the iPhone 17 - again
items.snippet: Figures for the second quarter of 2026 show that the iPhone 17 is once more the biggest selling smartphone around the globe, and that Apple takes the next two spots as well. The iPhone 17 is the world's best-selling smartphone According to previous figures from Counterpoint Research, the iPhone 17 was the best-selling smartphone in Q1 2026. But that was predicted, since in the months after launch, the trend in iPhone sales is to see an increase in the non-Pro models. Now the research firm says that the iPhone 17 has continued to be as successful. For Q2 2026, it again took the lead in a top ten of smartphone models by sales. Continue Reading on AppleInsider | Discuss on our Forums

items.title: iPhone Ultra motherboard may just have leaked
items.snippet: Apple has kept iPhone Ultra production details under lock and key better than it did with the iPhone Air, but at last there's a component leak. Or an over-detailed hoax. AppleInsider has long argued that if the much-rumored folding iPhone were to be launched in September, that we should be seeing leaked components. There's now been so much other evidence that it seems inevitable, but finally there has been a component leak. Allegedly. We won't know if these shots are really of the iPhone Ultra's motherboard until someone buys the costly device just to strip it apart. But now two seemingly separate leakers have produced different images of what do appear to be the same thing. Rumor Score: 🤯

items.title: M5 Max Mac Studio vs. M4 Max Mac Studio: Faster, more expensive
items.snippet: Apple's Mac Studio just got updated with M5 Max chip. Unlike the Mac mini, there's a strong argument to get or keep the prior model instead. M5 Max Mac Studio vs. M4 Max Mac Studio: Specs, hardware, price. After debuting in the MacBook Pro in March 2026, the M5 Max chip has made its way to Apple's top-of-the-line desktop, the Mac Studio. Though the Mac Studio hasn't undergone any visual changes, the M5 Max introduces significant under-the-hood enhancements. With Neural Accelerators in each GPU core and new "super cores" in the CPU, the M5 Max Mac Studio delivers impressive performance. Continue Reading on AppleInsider | Discuss on our Forums

items.title: OpenAI's lawsuit delays cause more harm every day, says Apple
items.snippet: Apple has pushed back against OpenAI's trying to delay the trade theft lawsuit while the AI company continues to profit from allegedly stolen information. Apple continues to press for expedited discovery in its case against OpenAI. Apple first filed suit against OpenAI over alleged mass IP theft in July 2026 . Since then, Apple has pressed for a faster start to the proceedings, and OpenAI has basically claimed that Apple is only suing because it can't compete . OpenAI has argued that Apple's asking for expedited discovery was simply unnecessary. Now Apple has responded to what it categorizes as OpenAI attempting to delay the suit Continue Reading on AppleInsider | Discuss on our Forums

items.title: M5 Ultra Mac Studio vs M3 Ultra Mac Studio: Apple's AI desktop, compared
items.snippet: Apple's top-tier Mac, the Mac Studio , has been given a big AI bump with the M5 Ultra. Here's how it compares against the M3 Ultra model it replaces. The Mac Studio now has M5 Ultra, an upgrade from the M3 Ultra. The new Mac Studio arrived on Tuesday , with the all-new M5 Ultra now the top-of-the-range chip for tough productivity workloads. Apple is positioning it squarely as a desktop for doing a lot of AI-related processing, including running models locally. The design stays faithful to the outgoing model, so the story lives inside the chip. This time, the headline is artificial intelligence rather than raw core counts.
